sql: CREATE TABLE t1(a INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,b,c,d)

SELECT a, CASE (b,c) WHEN (1,2) THEN 'aleph'
                       WHEN (2,3) THEN 'bet'
                       WHEN (3,4) THEN 'gimel'
                       ELSE '-' END,
         '|'
    FROM t1
   ORDER BY a

SELECT a, CASE (b,c,d) WHEN (1,2,3) THEN 'aleph'
                         WHEN (2,3,4) THEN 'bet'
                         WHEN (3,4,6) THEN 'gimel'
                         ELSE '-' END,
         '|'
    FROM t1
   ORDER BY a

            WHEN (1,2) THEN 'aleph'
            WHEN (2,3) THEN 'bet'
